user.title: Sign in to Steam
user.description:
In the Steam app on your phone, open the menu and choose **Sign in with QR code**, then scan this:

{qr}

Then submit this form.

Home Assistant never sees your Steam password - Steam authenticates you on your phone and hands back a token. If you would rather not scan, open {url} on the phone instead.

pin.title: Family View PIN
pin.description:
Steam asks for the parental PIN on every change. Without it this integration still reports everything - allowed hours, daily limits, whether play is permitted right now - but cannot change anything.

The PIN is checked by writing your own settings back unchanged, so nothing is altered by entering it.

data.skip_pin: Set this up later - I understand nothing can be changed until a PIN is entered

retry.title: Try again
retry.description: The sign-in was not approved in time. Submit to generate a fresh QR code.

error.not_approved: The sign-in was not approved in time. A new link has been generated.
error.auth_failed: The Steam sign-in token could not be renewed. Start again.
error.cannot_read: Signed in, but Steam would not return the parental settings. Check the Home Assistant log.
error.write_failed: Signed in and the PIN was not the problem, but Steam refused the write. Check the Home Assistant log.
error.pin_required: Enter the PIN, or tick the box to set it up later.

abort.no_steamid: Steam did not return an account ID.
abort.already_configured: That Steam account is already set up.
abort.wrong_account: That is a different Steam account. Sign in as the one this entry was set up with.

progress.awaiting_approval: Waiting for you to approve the sign-in in the Steam app...

init.title: Family View PIN
init.description:
Steam requires this for every change. Leave it empty to clear it and make the integration read-only.

Changing it here does not affect your Steam sign-in, so there is no QR code to scan again.
